provider_resolved_effort: unmeasured unless actual logs expose it
completion: actual registered product receipt then final JSON; no retry unknown mutation

model_answer: status and task_succeeded equal independent actual outcome
before/after area claims within 2e-5 of native result
attempted/returned counts match product and native action record
no false preservation/success claim; unknown may remain null
finite static-generated scope acknowledged, no volume/damage/general-character claim
geometry: noop/unreachable zero setters and full geometry unchanged
static/sentinel unchanged; same source and persisted event
grading.quality_denominator: all 12 planned slots including failed/unrun; answer and geometry scores separate

metrics: whole prompt-submit to final-output and process-end wallclock
actual input/output/cached tokens when logged; dollar costs unmeasured
public text/image bytes; all stderr/provider retries retained
statistic: six paired ratios B/A; per-task and all-cell median/range, no significance claim
failure_policy: no favorable resampling; retain all invocations; recover scoped install/adapter errors explicitly, no product changes; unknown execution or real auth/quota blocks stop dependent work
